question: The monthly incomes of two friends Tushar and Salil, are in the ratio 6 : 7 respectively and each of them saves ₹66,000 every month. If the ratio of their monthly expenditure is 2 : 4, find the monthly income of Tushar (in ₹).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Income Ratio: 6 : 7 | Expenditure Ratio: 2 : 4 | Savings = ₹66,000

Using Cross-Multiplication: (6 × 4) − (7 × 2) units = 66,000 × (4 − 2)

24 − 14 units = 66,000 × 2

10 units = 132,000 ⇒ 1 unit = 13,200

Tushar monthly income (6 units) = 6 × 13,200 = 79,200

**∴ Answer = 79200**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of incomes of Tushar and Salil = 6 : 7

Ratio of expenditures of Tushar and Salil = 2 : 4

Monthly savings of each = ₹66,000

**Formula used:**

Income − Savings = Expenditure
